body: Wave 1 at 19:45: Lane 5 (phone-composer-fullscreen) finished ok and is held, waiting for Lane 4 (day-and-log-sheets) to finish in the same worktree. Handoff: ~/.mitosis/field-notes/prototype-phone-macos/handoff/proto-phone-shell-lane-5.md.U+000AU+000ASpec gap: the 40-point Back and Save buttons on the phone composer were not built. They are drawn in lib/features/capture/text/text_composer_sheet.dart (`_exitPill`, `_saveButton`), which is in no Step's write-set. Their hit areas are already 48 tall through `_headerAction`'s kMinInteractiveDimension. The change: when resolveShellLayout(platform) is bottomBar, the exit pill and Save are 40 tall, Save with horizontal padding 14, radius 12 and 12-point text.U+000AU+000AExisting tests outside every write-set that Lane 5 breaks. The Worker verified each fix on a scratch export; I have not yet. All go into the post-wave-1 fix-up commit (decision 01M3ZNP8728RNFXY25MJGEFENF):U+000A1U+002E test/features/capture/core/text_composer_test.dart, the two scrim-tap tests: add `variant: TargetPlatformVariant.only(TargetPlatform.macOS)`, since the phone composer has no scrim now.U+000A2U+002E test/features/capture/core/composer_sprig_test.dart 'the sprig never overlaps header controls': in `_expectClearRightEdgeSprig`, subtract composerPanelBorderWidth only when the panel decoration's border is non-null.U+000A3U+002E test/features/capture/text/composer_keyboard_test.dart Tab-reach states c2-c8, c11, c19: in test/support/tab_reach.dart `_Stop.reaches`, change `target.rect.contains(rect.center)` to `target.rect.contains(rect.center) || rect.contains(target.rect.center)`. The wider full-screen composer leaves a 3.4-point sliver of a format button in the scroll viewport. Check this against shell-a11y's capture_states.dart once Lane 10 lands.U+000A4U+002E test/features/log_viewer/log_viewer_reader_test.dart 'the composer writes in the same 688 column in a 1280 window': give its MaterialApp `theme: ThemeData(platform: TargetPlatform.macOS)`.U+000A5U+002E Same file, 'the note viewer lays out a six hundred eighty eight pixel column in a 1280 pixel window': likely pin to macOS too (not verified; it also interacts with day-and-log-sheets).
